goal.objective: Evaluate the source electrical measurements and applicability of the two reversal arrangements.

enum: Source current or current-step magnitude under the declared baseline; not an isolated ion flux.
Source applied voltage under its retained sign convention.
Source reversal voltage under its own retained ionic conditions.
Conductance reported by the source, separate from the defined chord calculation.
Magnitude of applied minus applicable reversal voltage; the chord denominator.
Current magnitude divided by driving-voltage magnitude under supported condition applicability; not differential conductance.
Magnitude of electrical charge flow in elementary-charge equivalents per second; not ion identity, pore count or molecular turnover.
Conditional first-order variance of the defined chord from the supplied full primitive covariance.
Square root of conditional first-order chord variance; no confidence level is implied.
